description: This file defines the implementation of a delivery coordinator for reply dispatching in an auto-reply system, including functions for managing reply lifecycle, routing, editing, and delivery tracking.

classes.name: AcpDispatchDeliveryState
classes.description: Internal state tracking object for the delivery coordinator.

classes.name: ToolMessageHandle
classes.description: Represents a handle to a tool message with channel, account, recipient, thread, and message ID.

methods.name: normalizeDeliveryChannel
methods.description: Normalizes a delivery channel string by trimming and converting to lowercase.

methods.name: resolveDeliveryAccountId
methods.description: Resolves the account ID for delivery based on configuration, channel, and explicit account ID.

methods.name: shouldTreatDeliveredTextAsVisible
methods.description: Determines if delivered text should be treated as visible based on channel and reply kind.

methods.name: createAcpDispatchDeliveryCoordinator
methods.description: Factory function that creates and returns an AcpDispatchDeliveryCoordinator object with methods to manage reply delivery.
